name: Medicine Ball Lying Chest Throw
steps: Lie on a bench with your feet flat and hold the medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Brace your abs and pull your shoulder blades down against the bench.
Press the medicine ball explosively straight up toward the ceiling, releasing it cleanly into the air at full arm extension.
Watch the ball and meet it with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows as you catch it to slow its descent.
tips: Throw the ball straight vertically above your chest rather than drifting over your face.
Choose a light, manageable medicine ball so you can catch it safely and explosively.
